issues.legal_issue: The deduction from the assessed market value of acquired land must reflect the land’s developed status and location.
material_facts: The land was acquired for construction of a road, and the landowners appealed the compensation determination.

The High Court assessed the market value of irrigated and waste land at the same rate because of its residential and commercial potential, then deducted one-third because the land was somewhat away from the main road.
The land was within a well-developed area developed by the HUDA.
The Supreme Court found the one-third deduction harsh in light of the land’s developed status and considered a ten per cent deduction just.
issues.conclusion: The Court modified the compensation determination by replacing the one-third deduction from the assessed market value with a ten per cent deduction, while preserving the claimants’ entitlement to statutory benefits on the enhanced compensation.
issues.legal_principle: In determining compensation for acquired land, a deduction from assessed market value may account for the land’s location and development, but its extent must be justified by the circumstances. The Court held that a one-third deduction was not justified for land forming part of a well-developed area and that a ten per cent deduction was appropriate. The acquisition arose under Sections 4 and 17 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, and the landowners had sought a reference under Section 18. No earlier cases were cited for this ruling.

rule.if: land_acquisition_compensation_appeal and land_in_well_developed_area and land_is_some_distance_from_main_road and market_value_assessed_before_deduction

predicates.land_acquisition_compensation_appeal: The proceeding is an appeal challenging the compensation determined for acquired land.
predicates.land_in_well_developed_area: The acquired land forms part of a well-developed area.
predicates.land_is_some_distance_from_main_road: The acquired land is somewhat away from a main road.
predicates.market_value_assessed_before_deduction: The market value of the acquired land was assessed before a deduction was applied.

issues.definition: When an appeal concerns compensation for land in a well-developed area that is somewhat away from a main road and whose market value was assessed before deduction, the deduction is reduced to reflect the land’s developed status.
